global_style: A cinematic, richly illustrated digital painting in a single coherent collectible-card art universe: strong recognizable subject filling the frame, premium collectible-game concept-art quality, bright but sophisticated color grading (warm golds, teals, soft magentas), dramatic atmospheric lighting with visible depth and layered foreground/midground/background, painterly semi-realistic rendering (not flat vector, not photoreal photography), emotional storytelling in the pose and framing, aspirational lifestyle feeling of a brighter, more curious life.
global_restrictions: Portrait orientation, approximately 2:3 aspect ratio. Artwork only, no text of any kind, no logos, no wordmarks, no handwritten notes, no slogans, no hobby name or title, no rarity badge or label, no card frame or border, no card number, no icons, no UI elements, no watermark, no signature. Do not copy the layout, logo, typography, or card-frame design from the reference image; use it only to match illustration style, lighting, and color grading.
reference_instruction: Match the illustration technique, lighting mood, and color grading shown in the attached reference image, applied to a completely new scene for this hobby. Ignore all text, logos, frames, and UI in the reference image.

hobbies.title: Badminton
hobbies.subject: A young athletic player mid-lunge on an indoor badminton court, racket swung overhead in a smash motion, shuttlecock frozen in flight just above the racket.
hobbies.key_objects: badminton racket, shuttlecock, court lines, net in background
hobbies.recognition_test: Dynamic player + racket + shuttle + court/action feeling, readable as badminton within 2 seconds.
